notes.title: Patch Notes - 13/6/2019
notes.notes:
Good news a patch is due for release today, which includes the fix for the remapping issue ːsteamhappyː

[b]Patch Notes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Reverted Default power level to give better control of low power shots. addressing the table speed issue
[*] Fixed crash issue when going to controls remapping screen.
[*] Remapping of controls implemented.
[*] General bug fixes
[/list]

[b]NEXT patch will include: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed achievements 
[/list]
Anything else that is needed for the next patch please let us know 

Thanks again for your support, 

CherryPop

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 09/5/19
notes.notes:
Thank you for your feedback on the last build a patch will be released today. 
[b]
[i]Today's Patch will include: [/i]
[/b]

[list]
[*] Updated Room lighting 
[*] Update to balls - shiny balls returned 
[*] Fixed table brightness 
[*] Decrease maximum power to same as 2016 version ( This addresses the ball / table speed issue raised) 
[/list]

The [b]next patch[/b] is also in progress and can confirm it [b]will[/b] include fix for: 
[list]
[*] The crash on Remapping in profile 
[/list]
[i]Please comment below any other issues that need addressing in the next update [/i]

Thank you again for your feedback.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 30/4/19
notes.notes:
[b]Update patch notes. 
[/b]

[b]New mode: Snooker Plus now implemented  
New Snooker Plus championship
New Online Mode:  Leagues Online [/b]
Revamp of the AI utilising original WSC physics - the AI now play snooker and will play tactically 
Online stability improvements 
Crowd sounds applaud and react during matches 
Menu flow improvements 
Snooker Plus now implemented  
Aiming aid now shows the trajectory of the cue ball  
Local Multiplayer updated to make joining a Human Vs Human match clearer 
Save match progress during the tour  
Updated cameras to be more like Pool Nation 
Made 'forced retake' UI clearer  
Numerous bug fixes including but not limited to: 
Optimisations and performance improvements
Made powerbar clearer in overhead
Fixed exiting replays putting you into free cam
Updated to the latest version of UE4

[b]NOTE:[/b] There are some reported issues for certain monitors / graphic card settings on PC which we are looking into - however if you would like to access the old build until these issues are fixed then it can be accessed here:

[b]Steam branch:[/b] previousrelease

notes.title: Patch Notes #2 17th May 2016
notes.notes:
Build - V0.0.0.7

AI difficulty reduced for lower players.
Added more error to how well AI plays safety shots
AI Player names are now editable. Alter the SnookerNation/Content/Editable/PlayerNames.txt file
Unused plugins (oculus, leap motion etc) disabled
'Invite friends' hint on lobby screen showed Right mouse instead of left mouse button
Improved lighting in snooker lounge
Improved loading screen for spectators
Made pocket leather a 'richer creamier' colour
Updated red and pink ball materials
Updated baize material
Update lighting in all rooms
Changed 'Push Shot' to 'Push Stroke'
Referee now announces correct frame when loading a saved champ match
Fixed 100 and 147 break achievements
Fix for pause menu in championship showing incorrect number of frames

notes.title: Patch Notes #1 - 9th May 2016
notes.notes:
Thank you beta testers for your help on testing the first patch for Snooker Nation, the next patch will be on the BETA branch today and this patch is now live :) 

Patch notes below: 

Crowd sounds should now be correctly linked to the 'crowd' volume slider in settings
Fix for flashbacks not restoring whether you were on reds/colours for the shot you flash back to
Fixed incorrect frames being shown during championship
Fixed issue with being sometimes sent back to versus screen when backing out of championship
Fix for music becoming insanely loud after a few games
Tour difficulty now correctly taken into account when choosing your opponents
Lowered the default camera height to be closer to the cue
Set default cue distance to 'mid range' to be closer to real life head position
Fixed issue with being taken to the PoolNationVR store page
Fix for resolution setting defaulting to 640x480 when alt-tabbing out
Achievements + Icons now added. More to follow soon 
Fixed lobbies in snooker hall showing '8ball' 
Removed decal when chosen decal is 'none'
Removed W.I.P leagues option until complete
Updated the 'TV Cam' position to more closely match TV coverage
Reduced difficulty of AI
Fix for timing related crash when joining online matches
Achievements + Icons now added. (More to follow)
